title: Pay The Price: Pleasure Now Regret Later

sense.text:
“And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.” The Pharisees asked, “Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?” Why is Christ sitting with ungodly people? He sat and communed with them to bring them to repentance. That was the whole purpose.

That is why he said he did not come for the righteous but for the sinners. So if you think you are right, he is not here for you. The first step of changing is to acknowledge that we have issues.

All of us come into this truth sick, with sins. Don't come to this truth with rose colored glasses on thinking everything is going to be perfect. We are going to see the same issues and the same situations in here that we saw in the world. The only difference is that now we have to apply the scriptures to remedy these things. The scriptures can cure us. This book has zero power until you apply what it says: until then it is just a page with ink on it. The word comes alive when you manifest it in your life and allow it to guide you and move you, and then you see the power of God. It is somewhat of a mental disorder to come into this truth and never evolve, never grow, never measure up.

There is a foul spirit of fornication in the congregation. Fornication will always be around till Christ returns, but that does not negate that we have to change, men and women both: there are hoes out there too, and whoremongers, and it has to change. If you don't want the kingdom, take off the purple and the fringe and go back to the club and twerk. At the end you are not going to get it anyway.

“I will have mercy, and not sacrifice.” What we used to do was always give up sacrifices to absolve us of the sins we committed. That's not how it works. Sacrifice was given to us because we sinned against God, but that is not how it was supposed to be from the beginning. We kept on choosing sin. He is saying, I want to see you change rather than continue sacrificing.

“For I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.” Are there any that are righteous? No. So the ones he did not come to call are those who believe they are righteous, who think they are holy. Many people are right in their own eyes. We don't want to see ourselves in a negative light; we want to see the best side of us, and act like the parts of us that are not right are going to be all right with God. If we continue in that mindset of not changing, not becoming better, not becoming more disciplined, we will fall short of the kingdom.

In these times it is more imperative that we change. Many of us came to this truth after we lived a life of sin, which is good and bad: we have a reference point to show the young ones, don't follow this path, there is no good in it. And you who were born in this truth, don't destroy your name. If you are a virgin in this truth you are an anomaly in this earth, breaking these generational curses. Young girls and young boys, stay off the porn; you are destroying yourself.

He came to save the sinner. That was me. I was a sinner above measure, and thank you, Lord, for coming to save me.

precepts.why:
“Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed.” You have to confess your faults so that we can pray, and you can be healed. There is no healing without confession.

You can't cherry-pick what you want from the Bible and expect to be received of God and Christ. You have to confess your faults that you can be healed. That is what Christ came for: I came for the sick, those that need healing. He came to call sinners to repentance, and the healing starts with owning the sin.

So what do we use to heal ourselves? The word of God. “He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.” Write that down: he sent his word down to heal them.

If you know what the will of God is, you are ahead of the whole world, because people out here are crazy. People think you can still eat pork, or vote for Trump, or whatever people are doing in this world. But we know his word is what is going to heal.

The word of God can cure. Ezra speaks of “them that are cured with his word”, and if the Most High did not forgive, “There should be very few left peradventure in an innumerable multitude.”

That is why Christ said, I didn't come for the righteous, I came for the sick, and I am going to give them my word so they can be healed and they can be cured. So the word of God will cure you; it will heal you. When James says to confess your faults one to another and pray one for another that ye may be healed, it means we have to apply the word of God.

“Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.” That is the man who thinks he is righteous. The Most High ponders the minds of men. Some people have secret thoughts that nobody knows but them, and the Lord. We walk in with the fringes and the beard, we look the part, we can pull the precepts; he looks godly, he sounds godly. The Most High says, that ain't right. A man doesn't want to see himself as anything but a good man: I have a little porn addiction, but I'm all right. The fornication being reported is unbelievable, and if that misconduct is not changed, you are not receiving the kingdom. You are just not going.

Matthew says “I will have mercy, and not sacrifice”, and Proverbs says the same: “To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.” They thought sacrifice was going to absolve them. When we repent to the Lord and say, Lord, we're sorry, and then go back and do the same thing again, we are not really sorry. We send up prayers and fast and then return to the same behavior; we are not really sorry, and we don't really understand the fear of God. To know to do right and not do it is sin, and to know right and still do wrong is presumptuous sin. We have all been guilty of that, but there has to be a day we stop, or we won't receive the kingdom.

When you keep doing the same thing over and over, you are getting further away from God: “The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.” You keep doing the same thing and wonder why life is not working out for you. Spiritual men and women are supposed to ask, what's going on, why isn't it working? Could it be that you have a secret life?

We all want the kingdom, so we have to change on this end. We can't wait and think that in the kingdom we are going to become somebody different. Bring forth fruits meet for repentance.

sense.text: “For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.” In Adam all died because of his sin, and in Christ we have the opportunity to be made alive, because he is the word that quickeneth. We are being resurrected now. Prior to this truth we were not spiritually alive; we were dead, following the course of this world.

“Christ the firstfruits.” Christ is the first perfect man, the first one accepted by God. When you gave firstfruits to God, you gave him the first of your crops and the first of your animals, without blemish. That is how we have to be: without blemish. If we come before the Lord in that day still holding on to secret sins, we are not going to be accepted. The Lord is only going to accept firstfruits, so that is what we have to become.

Christ is the benchmark we look to and measure ourselves against. We look to his life and become like him, so that when it is time to come before the Lord we are accepted. We know that in this body we have sinned against God and we fall short, but that does not give us the license to continue in the same lifestyle and expect to obtain the kingdom.

We need to be the example when the masses come. They have to see a singularity in the way we conduct ourselves, where we hold each other accountable to the laws of God, and hold our children and each other's children accountable, so that when people see us they know we are different. That means we have to heal ourselves of whatever we have been going through sin-wise, so we can present ourselves as the firstfruits.

“For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.” Christ is coming to subdue all enemies and put all underneath his feet. But we have to become as Christ, every man in his own order, after the firstfruits.

“Flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.” “For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.” This corruptible man must put on incorruption.

“So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption”: when this corruptible man puts on incorruption, he is walking in the laws of God. Then “Death is swallowed up in victory.” It will be swallowed up, but you have to put that on.

Do not be deceived by being taught, or by thinking, that we can continue the way we are and then when it is time the Lord is going to look at someone and say, don't worry about it. That's not how it works. There is no sin we do in this body that we will not answer for in his time. Everything is going to be brought into judgment. So let's stack up some good fruits towards God to try to abolish what we did wrong. It is a level of insanity to think anything different; something has been communicated to you that is deceiving you. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

“Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty.” Don't continue to stare at it. If you know that is your device, you need to turn away. Where does it begin? With your eyes. Your eyes are directly correlated with your mind; they work in sync. What you see will make your mind react a certain way, so the best thing to do is turn away.

Turning your head away and not looking shows that you have self-control, that you have control of your members and can move them about the way you want to. But if you can't turn away, Christ ain't the captain of this ship. Satan is running the show. If you ever saw a woman and did not turn your head, Satan was driving, and you knew consciously, I'm not supposed to be looking.

“For many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman”: what is happening at that moment is that you are being deceived. Your eyes and your heart, your mind, are directly connected, and your mind is desperately wicked, so the best thing to do is turn away. The sisters have their own things too. You see something inappropriate online, and not even porn, which is obvious, just something that ain't right, and you find yourself clicking and looking. You are not in control. You are down that rabbit hole looking for that feel good, because sin feels good. It is enjoyable.

“For herewith love is kindled as a fire.” Because you have not turned away, love is kindled. To kindle something is to blow on it. It starts as a little flame, a little ember, but you keep nurturing it by blowing on the flame, and then it becomes inflamed. That is how the two elders of Susanna's history were: at that man's house, lusting after his wife day in and day out, entertaining those thoughts, never turning their heads away, until each of them doubled back to creep and peep, and they busted each other. Their plan was, let’s see if we both can sleep with her. Wicked. It is the same lust inflaming a brother who, as the bread was about to be broken on the Sabbath, leaned over and asked another brother to go to the strip club when they were done. That is bold.

precepts.why:
Moses chose “rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season.” Because you enjoy that pleasure of sin for a season, you are going to pay the price for it. There is a price that is going to be paid.

That pleasure is just for a season. Then afterwards, what do you have? That little season we deem pleasure is only pleasure because your mind has convinced you it is, and that is because you made an agreement with your eyes to continue looking. That is what got David caught up. He could not look away; he did not look away, and it brought all the other problems that came along with it.

“If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes”: if my heart followed and walked after what I saw. Your eyes are directly correlated with how you think. What you ingest into your eyes affects how your mind thinks.

“If mine heart have been deceived by a woman”: many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman. Why are you deceived? Because you looked and did not turn away. A simple motion, turning your head, could have saved you a world of problems. “Or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door; Then let my wife grind unto another.” “For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.” The heinous crime is that you did not turn your eye away, and now you find yourself in adultery or fornication.

“I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?” I made an agreement with my eyes. “Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?”

“Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?” For the Lord to see your ways and count your steps means he knows what is in your mind. He knows what you are looking at and how you think. Brothers think nobody sees what they are doing, and sisters think nobody sees. Do you read the Bible? I see everything, I know everything; everything is being recorded. Because judgment is not executed speedily, the brothers think they are getting away with it. But in that day everything is going to come to your remembrance. He will open the book and measure you against the book of your life, and we are not going to escape it.

sense.text: “And shall utterly perish in their own corruption.” There it is: corruption. In 1 Corinthians 15 you had to change from one thing to the other, from corruption to incorruptible. If you can't cease from sin, you are not changing; you perish in your own corruption.

“As they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time.” That riot is fornication. “Spots they are and blemishes”: another word for spot is a blot. You are a spot, you are a blot, because your eyes are full of sin, full of lust that you are unable to stop.

“Sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you.” While they sit and feast with you, they are deceiving themselves. You ain't getting the kingdom; that is madness. They are spots, they have a blot, and they feast amongst us, with a subscription to Pornhub. A brother put out of the body for fornication, still being judged for it, downloaded a dating app and set up a date, and the woman he met turned out to have just visited the school. People just don't want to be right. You don't know who is watching. Pay attention to how we move, because people are watching us, and we have to be the best example we can be.

“Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin.” You have made a covenant that you cannot cease from sin, because your eye, which is connected to your mind, is full of all manner of immorality. You cannot get off that porn site, and you have to go to work in the morning. Satan is driving now. When you can't stop doing something that you know is wrong, you have no control of that body, and Christ does not dwell in you; Satan is directing your path. Stick your hand into fire and you pull it back. If you can't pull back from the porn, it is because you are beguiled.

“Beguiling unstable souls”: they beget other dummies. “Cursed children”: you are cursed, because you have no control.

“An heart they have exercised with covetous practices.” They not only have the thought, they entertain it; they exercise the thought. When you exercise, you get stronger. They strengthen those thoughts by continuing to entertain them, to the point that they cannot cease, because now it is stronger than the spiritual side of them, whatever is left of it. You thought nobody knows, and now Satan is more powerful than the spiritual side of you. Christ said, I can't deal with anybody subject to sin.

The internet is a trap, and it is destroying the young people's minds, and not only through porn. YouTube shorts, ten or fifteen seconds long, are brain rot. Your mind is being trained to have a short attention span, always looking for a quick dopamine hit, a quick feel good. That is why you can't read a book or watch a program through to the end unless it is sexed up or evil; you can't watch a program on animals in the Serengeti because it is boring. It is the same with porn: always looking for something salacious, something extra. It is a drug. Watching somebody chewing on a screen doesn't cause you to think at all. All of it is meant to destroy the minds of the people. Satan is playing on a high level.

When you read a book to the end, even through the parts that are not interesting, you endured. You stayed the course. You are being trained not to have the spirit to endure, and in this truth there will be times when things are not 100 percent, when you don't feel good, and you still have to endure and not give in.

Eyes full of adultery is in the body, even among children as young as twelve and fourteen, and one of fourteen, asked if he wanted to change, said plainly that he did not want to stop. A lawyer’s wife had to put a camera in the house to catch her husband with the animals; imagine being married to a man like that, and be careful who you marry. And there are brothers in the body putting on their wives’ drawers. Sisters and brothers, watch your children. At the tabernacles and the feast days, have them on your hip. We have a responsibility to guide them. What checks and balances are in a child's life when his eyes are full of fornication at twelve?

precepts.why:
“If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands.” Any blot cleaving to the hands means the actions now. Your eyes are full of adultery, and now you are acting out all that you are seeing, all that you imagine in your mind, and now you have a blot.

Remember the blot, then go back to Peter: “Spots they are and blemishes.” Another word for spot is a blot. The eyes go first, the heart walks after the eyes, the hands act it out, and the man is spotted.

Growing up in America is why so many youth are dabbling in these activities, because America is the damn devil the Bible speaks of. It is literally witchcraft going on with public television, on Netflix, in the programming and the cartoons. Even in the cartoons they put subliminal messages, putting those thoughts in our children's minds. As parents we are responsible. Sitting your child down in front of the TV is not parenting. We have to spend time, go over the scriptures, study, ask questions, be involved in their lives, and not let America teach our children.

“For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest.” Bewitching is something so fascinating, attractive or enchanting that it captures your complete attention as if holding you under a spell. America was built on witchcraft, on sorcery. And what is honest? The scriptures, God's laws. We teach our children God's commandments, then send them to school, and once they get home sit them in front of the TV, and all that honesty, all the good they learned at the Sabbath and the new moon, America will take away if we don't monitor and stay involved in their lives.

“And the wandering of concupiscence doth undermine the simple mind.” Concupiscence is evil sexual desires. It looks enticing, it looks good, and that is what takes away their minds. Remember the eyes we just read: eyes full of adultery.

Eyes full of adultery. “Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck.” We know the history of our sister Judith, but the point is that his heart was so full of lust that her shoes ravished his eyes. Who looks at a woman's shoes like that? People are crazy.

“Her beauty took his mind prisoner”: he is now under it. He has no self-control. “And the fauchion passed through his neck”: he got killed behind it. That is the point. Eyes full of adultery, a mind taken prisoner, and death at the end of it.

sense.text: “My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations.” Why count it joy? “Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.” Your faith is being tried, and it is going to work out. Can you endure?

“But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.” Entire, whole, lacking nothing. You have to go through it so you can learn. You learn what your shortcomings are and you work on them.
“If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.” If you lack wisdom, ask of God.

“Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.” Here is one way to endure temptation: turn away. Turn. Don't look.

“Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God.” God does not tempt you. When you are tempted, it is not God tempting you; it is what is in you already. I am not tempted with shooting myself or cutting myself or sticking my hand in fire, and I am not tempted by no dude; that's not my get down. You are only tempted with the things that you like. So if you don't like it, you can change your mind. We can train our minds to change the way we think. That is the renewing of your mind.

“But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.” A man is only tempted with his own lust. Enticed means he entertains it. He is drawn away of his own lust, he entertains it, he exercises it, and it gets stronger and stronger and stronger.

“Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin.” When lust has fully conceived, when his eyes and his heart are full of adultery, it brings forth sin: then you act on it. “And sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.” The end result is that you act on it.

That is how you get men in the body so full of lust that they get down on their knees on a dirty bathroom floor to look under a stall, or glue a mirror to a shoe to look up skirts on the escalator, or walk around trying to take pictures of a woman's panty line. That is a rapist mentality. If you do that, you better stop. And trust me, if you are doing that, you have been doing so much more in your private life. You are fully gone.

“Do not err, my beloved brethren.” Do not err. Some brothers hear this word but they are not really doers. They hear it and it sounds good. Sisters too: they hear it, but they don't really want to change.

“Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.” As you get right you are removing the spots, so that you can be firstfruits to God. That is what we have to become: without spot, without blemish.

We have to fix it on this end. We are not going over there to fix it. This is the playing field; this is the condition of the battle. If you are brought under subjection of something you can't control, whether lust or hatred or whatever it might be, and the word of God is not engrafted in you, this ain't for you. Whoever it is, including myself, we are not going. Is it impossible to be the firstfruits, unspotted? No. It is only impossible if your heart is full of adultery or sin that you don't want to change.

“Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.” If you are listening you are not talking. Be swift to hear and slow to speak, and don't get mad when you hear it. You are not making excuses; you are fixing yourself and getting right.

“Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness.” Superfluity is an excessive amount, an oversupply, an abundance of something far beyond what is needed. That is people who have no self-control: the man who stands at the escalator in the mall all day trying to look up, the man who walks past women in tight spaces trying to rub against them.

“And receive with meekness the engrafted word.” To engraft is to join or fix something so deeply and securely that it becomes a permanent, functioning part of a new whole. The word of God is supposed to be engrafted in our minds, permanent, seared into our minds, so that we do the right thing and move right. If your mind is full of adultery and fornication, the word of God is not engrafted in there, because you have been exercising yourself in all the wrong things. Exercise yourself in the word of God so that it becomes one with your thoughts. For the word of God to have power it has to become a verb in your life, an action you are doing, or you are just reading words on a page. Engrafted, it becomes like a knee-jerk reaction.

To lay apart is to repent and put it away from you: mortify, discipline your members on the earth. Meekness is to humble yourself down. Don't be like a lawyer, making justification in your mind for your actions: I'm going through it, nobody knows, it's hard, my wife makes me mad and I need somebody to talk to. Nobody cares; the scripture says what it says. Either you do it and prove to God you love it, or you don't. Your heart is desperately wicked and there is no justification for this. We must keep the commandments. You can study all the prophecies and all the deep breakdowns, but if you don't have the word of God concerning this engrafted in your mind, you are just making noise.

The engrafted word is able to save your souls. “But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.” That is how you know the word of God is engrafted: you become a doer. It is a verb. If it is engrafted in your mind, you are going to do what it says. It becomes part of you, so deeply connected that you do it without even thinking, because it is part of your makeup. It is a reflex. If not, you are deceiving yourself.

“For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.” When you look in the mirror it gives you a view of yourself. What gives us a view of ourselves right now? This book. We learn ourselves when we see it. But if you see it and turn away from it, you forget what manner of man you are supposed to be.

You can turn away from the mirror, but you are still the same demon you were. You can close the Bible, but that doesn't change that the word of God is not engrafted in you. You didn't put away the superfluity of naughtiness or the filthiness; you just don't want to hear it or see it, so you move away from the book, away from the correction, away from being told. Nobody sees you, so you think you are all right, and in that day you think you'll just slip in because the Lord knows your heart. Your heart is evil. If we want to level up as prophets, if the sisters want to level up in this truth, we have to grow. We have to lay aside lust, and any type of sin in us, so we can measure up, or we will not receive the kingdom.

“But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.” He is blessed because he is applying what he learned. Prior to applying these things in our lives, we had a blot, a spot.

“To keep himself unspotted from the world.” The world is out to spot you, to put a blot on you. To keep yourself from it is to turn away from what the world is doing. You know certain things are not good for your spirit: turn it off. Show self-control.

“To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction”: when you get yourself right, then you go and teach the people who don't have that hedge or guide. A woman without a husband doesn't have a guide; you are supposed to go teach her to repent. A child without a father, you are supposed to be that hedge in his life to show him right. But first you have to get yourself right, listen, change, and get the word of God engrafted in you, so we can raise the next generation with it engrafted in them, and the next, and then we get up out of here. Or you are just spinning your wheels and deceiving yourself.

precepts.why:
How are we led away from doing right? “For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain. For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.” That is how we are destroyed.

The corruptible body is at war with your spiritual soul. The only way to have a real chance of fighting and defeating it is for the word of God to become engrafted in us. You are supposed to be in that book regularly. It is difficult and nearly impossible to open this book, be studying every day and really applying it, and then go straight from that into sinning. And it is very difficult to go from sinning back into the book regularly. Wherever your love is, that is where you dwell. Nobody reads about our history and the laws of God and then goes to fornicate.

The path to fornication generally leads from this book being kept closed. You are not occupying, not reading your four chapters a day, not really in the book, and you slowly wander away into it. And once you wander away, it is a fight to come back, because now your heart is full of sin and you are bound by your sins. Without the word engrafted in you, you don't have a fighting chance.

The mind “museth upon many things.” When you muse upon something, when you entertain it, you only entertain it because it is pleasurable to you.

“Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in.” If you find delight in that, you have to ask yourself, why am I delighted, why do I entertain something that is evil?

“But remember they shall not go unpunished unto their grave.” The second part is the part that matters. Remember that there is a punishment for it. They will not go unpunished, and you will not go unpunished if you find pleasure in sin. Lust conceives and brings forth sin, and sin finished brings forth death.

“Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.” Many times brothers envy how sinners live. Young people envy these rappers and the cares of this world, and they get caught up. You see the house, you see the girls, you see the car. You are seeing with your eyes, your eyes are instructing your mind, and your mind begins to envy, because that is where envy happens: I want that, I want to be part of that. When you entertain that, you are saying this book is not important, that is important, and you are telling God, that is what I choose. That is the reason we went into captivity: we did not serve the Lord with joyfulness and gladness of heart for the abundance of all things. That is how we ended up right here in Miami.

“For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off. Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.” It is telling us to change: guard our minds in the way of these commandments and these laws.

“Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.” Your eyes will behold an evil woman and your heart will begin to utter perverse things. What do you utter from? Your mouth. Your eye is connected to your mind, and your mind is connected to your mouth. You see, you entertain, then you begin to talk: let me get your number, what's going on. You have no self-control of your members now. Eye, mind, mouth. Out of the abundance of your heart your mouth speaks, and then you are caught up. A man is drawn away of his own lust and enticed.

“Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.” A man is wise in his own eyes. Take heed lest you fall: that is walking circumspect.

“There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.” The Lord is going to give you a way to escape: right here, this book, where you behold your face in the glass. He will send people into your life to instruct you and show you to change. You will hear that and know the Lord is giving you a way to escape, and say, but I don't want to escape. I want to stay in the same place and still say I believe in God. Does that work? No.

“Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry”: whatever your god is. “I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.” Judge what was just said.

“Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.” You can't do both. You have to choose one. If you are doing both, you are lukewarm, and the Lord said he would rather you be hot or cold. We know the cold are not getting the kingdom, and the lukewarm are not getting the kingdom. You can't have it both ways.

He will give you a way to escape, and that is why James says to count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations: the trying of your faith works patience. Can you endure?

If you lack wisdom, ask of God. This is the prayer: “Search me, O God, and know my heart.” Lord, search me. Show me my heart; let me know about me. “Try me, and know my thoughts”: try me against your word, and then you know how I think. Am I applying it?

“And see if there be any wicked way in me.” See if there is any evil in me. He asks that because he knows he cannot serve two masters: Lord, show me where I am falling short. “And lead me in the way everlasting”: put this word, engraft it in me, that I can be better and do better.

How does that happen? Open the book and search the scriptures. Look at yourself in that mirror. And he will send prophets into your life to instruct you. There was a class that came out recently, and a person who had been praying and fasting all week watched it and said it was the answer to exactly what they needed to know to make a decision. The brother who taught the class and that person don't even communicate, but it was spot-on, and it changed their life and put them on the right course. Sometimes the Lord will send prophets into your life to tell you what is wrong. This class is for somebody.

It is not impossible to be incorruptible, unspotted and without blemish, but we need the spirit of Christ. “For she is the breath of the power of God”: this is speaking of Christ, the wisdom and the power of God. “And a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.” When we are following Christ and Christ is working through us, no defiled thing can flow through.

“For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of God, and the image of his goodness.” The unspotted mirror: we follow the example of Christ, who did no sin.

“And being but one, she can do all things.” It is not impossible. It is only impossible when the Bible is shut, when we are not holding up our end of the bargain. “And remaining in herself, she maketh all things new”: we become new creatures in Christ when we decide to repent and get our minds right. “She maketh them friends of God.”

“For God loveth none but him that dwelleth with wisdom.” The Lord is letting it be known who he loves. “For after this cometh night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom.” No matter what vice or hang-up, what sin or lust we have, no vice can overcome the wisdom of God. If we want to come out of here on the other end, we have to get it right on this end. That is very easy English. We cannot have it rule us.

sense.text: “Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.” If your expectation is to be called a son of God in the kingdom, then don't let sin reign or rule in this mortal body. We have to have the word of God engrafted in our souls, so that sin does not reign in us and does not rule us.

“Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.” Don't yield your members to sin, because you are expecting the kingdom. That is what we are all doing this for.

“For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.” The payment for sin is death, and through Christ is eternal life. Isn't that what we are looking for? When we keep the commandments, what are we doing it for? The kingdom. God says that if you keep the commandments he is going to give you the kingdom, so you are expecting the kingdom.

precepts.why:
“For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.” “Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.” That is what our expectation is supposed to be.

If we know the wages of sin is death, then why sin? If you sin, you are not expecting this; you know what you are going to get. In that day you are going to say, Lord, Lord, and he is going to say, you didn't do what I said to do. I don't know you. How do you expect something if you didn't do it?

“Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.” That is the part of us that groans to God because we are expecting the kingdom, if you are sincere: I want the kingdom, I don't want to come up short, Lord, please preserve me, help me. Well then, let the word be engrafted in your mind. He is telling you what to do. “And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit.”

“And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.” If you love God, you are keeping the commandments. It works for good to those keeping the commandments, who have the word engrafted in them.

“For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son.” Those that followed him before will follow him again; they are predestinated. To be conformed to the image of his Son is to measure to the full stature of Christ in this mortal body, because sin cannot reign in this mortal body. Don't think it is going to happen on the other side. The person who lives a life of sin thinking they are going to the kingdom is not going; they are going to be in the lake.

Sisters who are married: you are not receiving the kingdom if you are not abiding in your husband. If you refuse to serve him, look at him as your lord and obey the little things he tells you, like washing the dishes before bed, you are not going, no matter how many head covers you wear or what offices you have. If Jesus told you, you would do it. And husbands, if you are not guiding your wives in these scriptures and showing them how to be that woman, that is your fault. You are no wise master builder. Then your kids are cursed. When a child of twelve is in gay porn, something is wrong in that house.

sense.text:
“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.” Wiles are clever, deceptive or seductive tricks, and stratagems. A stratagem is a strategy, something well planned out: if we set this in place here and this in place there, we will achieve this result, and it may not be right away.

The act of homosexuality has been around from the beginning, but those over 55 remember a time it was not as common, when you didn't see it openly, and the punk in the neighborhood got bullied. That is not advocating violence against anybody: whoremonger or homo, it is the same judgment from God. But what happened from then till now? Stratagems. TV shows and movies and policies passed in America were set in place that made it acceptable, so now you see it as normal. There is no hit show without it, even when the storyline is about a man with leukemia. These were plans and popular persuasions to change the minds, so that the young generation is not shocked.

The brainwashing began back then. Flip Wilson played Geraldine and we laughed; we thought it was funny. When we laughed at that we were taking pleasure in sin and seeing it as a joke, and our inhibitions and our values were being lowered. Then came Madea, Martin's Sheneneh, Tootsie. Thirty, forty, fifty years ago dudes wearing dresses would never have been acceptable; now thugs walk around with extendos and fingernail polish. Even the cartoons: Bugs Bunny used to live in a hole in the ground and Daffy Duck in the woods, and now they live together and are posted as couple goals. They play above most people's heads. It is seduction on a level: nothing overtly sexual, but at a young age it molds the mind slowly, so that it becomes natural to see. All the pronouns, trans and cis, are to distort the minds. These are the wiles of the devil.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” So what was the strategy? Back then it was Moab. Today the majority of the pornography sites are controlled by Amalek, and Edom too; the old XXX video places were Amalek. They understood: we are going to destroy the minds of the people.

That is why all our music is so derogatory and evil. You think we are the only race having sex? No, but every video is a twerk video, and you see somebody's grandmother twerking online. Everything is oversexualized to destroy these young people's minds. They understood: we will get them on drugs, on whoring, on music.

precepts.why:
“And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab. And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.” What would cause us to bow down to their gods? It says they committed whoredom. It was sex that got the people to worship another god, and “the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.”

“For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor.” They vex you with their seduction, and they beguiled you into worshipping their gods. They knew: we have to get these people to sin against God. We will use this tricknology, this stratagem, to move them away from God. That was their popular plan, and those are the wiles of the devil.

sense.text: “For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” The enemies are the other nations, the heathen. The nations hate God because he chose us.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” Who are God's people? We are God's people. Their crafty counsel is their wiles, their strategies on how to destroy us.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance. For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee.” All of the nations have come together with one consent.

We need to understand that in this world, all we have is us. The nations as a collective don't care. They have all played a part in our demise and in taking advantage of us, and we have served captivity to all of them. Even when they war against each other, like Ishmael warring against Amalek right now, know for certain that the Ishmaelites enslaved us just like Amalek had a part in it.

precepts.why:
“Therefore the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtilly with them, and brought them low with labouring in brick, and made them slaves.” This is one of their crafty counsels: we are going to work them to death.

Today many of our people are working two jobs, paycheck to paycheck, too poor to stop working, and more so now with Trump in office. There is no middle class. You can't work for a living wage and survive out here. There was a time you could deliver milk or eggs, or work in the post office, and buy a home on one salary. Not anymore. People work full-time jobs making $50,000 a year in LA and are homeless, living in storage units.

They said, we have to find ways to keep the children of Israel under our foot. If we can't get them in religion, we will get them in the workforce; if not the workforce, gangs; if not gangs, porn. We will turn them into criminals. Put the right conditions on any people, whatever color they are, and they will do crime. Young ones who sit and watch porn all day fry their brains, and they act it out on somebody closest to them who is younger, somebody they can take advantage of. That is how these rapists get turned on.

“Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.” This is what they understood. Balaam was a heathen prophet. The Lord would not allow Balaam to curse us, but he told Balak the king: I can't curse them, but I can tell you how to make them fall. Whoredom.

As long as we continue in whoredom, with this porn or whatever people are doing, we will not build healthy marriages, and without healthy marriages we will not produce spiritually healthy children, which keeps the generational curses going. Our strength is to come back to the laws of God. That is what will unify husbands and wives, and the children will be in the right frame of mind, prepared to marry other believers' children and bring back a nation. While we are still on the twerk and controlled by porn, the nation stays dysfunctional.

And it is in the body: a brother at the men's conference sent a picture of his private parts to another brother's wife; a sister whose husband committed adultery committed adultery to get back at him. You turned yourself into a hole to get back at your man: not just a hole, a stupid hole. Ladies, that label don’t wipe off very easy. God is going to judge him too, but that is not the way. And at Tabernacles a brother got mad, left, went and performed fellatio on some guy in the world, and came back to Tabernacles. We come to this truth sick, but people are crazy. Imagine us as a nation not able to use the word of God to heal and fix ourselves. The word of God is not engrafted in a mind that thinks that is the way to get back.

“Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.” Then he loved Delilah, and the lords of the Philistines said to her, “Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him.” Entice him and find out how to defeat him. The weapon they used against him was his weakness for sex. That was his weakness, and they knew he gives in.

Brothers especially: everything you do online is being recorded. There is a dossier, a file, on whatever you are looking at. If you keep scrolling through one kind of woman, they can dispatch a woman along the lines you like, and she strikes up a conversation and you think she was sent from Jesus. No, that was COINTELPRO, and you got caught. Then you lay on her chest telling her all your business.

“And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.” Tell me what time the bishop is coming in.

“If there be any error in this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them. But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them.”

When we are in the laws of God, God is going to defend us. When we are in error, we leave ourselves open for destruction. The nations understand this, so they keep us on that evil rap music, on drugs, in error with God. Once we are able to make that connection back with God, we are all right; we are going to get up out of here, and they understand that. Their wiles are their strategies, and they keep layers and layers of things to keep us in error, even food they serve us that we don't know is unlawful. Their whole plan is to keep us in sin.

sense.text: “And the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.” What is that rose up to play? You think it is hopscotch? It was fornication, and Corinthians explains it.

precepts.why:
“Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.” It is saying the same thing again. “Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” When they lusted after evil things, that is the rose up to play.

“But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.” Why were they overthrown in the wilderness? Because they lusted after evil things. “Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.” The rose up to play was fornication. They lusted after evil things and it destroyed us.

The nations understood this: when we are in sin, they can destroy us. When they took counsel they said, how do we keep these people in error? They like to rap; let them make murder music and lascivious music. That is why the sisters in the music are so vulgar, and now a song saying the world would be boring without hoes is held up as a women's empowerment anthem.

sense.text:
“And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” What happened when God saw that? It grieved him, and he killed us. He flooded the whole earth.

Today people have no shame. The enemy said, I will put the people they hold in high esteem in situations and make them abominable. I will give a few of them riches for them to destroy the rest of them. That is the music, and that music is only being made because they have changed the minds of the people to entertain it and like it. Now when a sister is honorable they look at her like she is a pick me. Somebody picked you to marry you; that is good. Or would you rather just be a sperm receptacle, picked every Friday night?
“My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.” God is saying, give me your mind. Look to me. Let me control how you think. Engraft my words into your mind.

“For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.” My son, pay attention to me; put your eyes on me, because she is a deep ditch. Don't look that way. Don't turn your eye that way. I am trying to save you, I am trying to guide you. Give me your mind.

Now the question is, what do you want? You are telling me you want pleasure now? Fine. You are going to get regret later. You are going to pay.

“She also lieth in wait as for a prey.” She is lying in wait for a sucker. A prey is an animal that is weak and cannot defend itself. The prey is a weak-minded man: the man who would sleep with a woman who tells you openly she has venereal diseases. That is a prey. “And increaseth the transgressors among men”: she is stacking them up.

precepts.why:
“And the two elders saw her going in every day, and walking; so that their lust was inflamed toward her.” We know the history. “And they perverted their own mind”: because the lust inflamed them, they perverted their own minds. They entertained these thoughts.

“And turned away their eyes, that they might not look unto heaven.” They turned their eyes away from God. We just read it: give me your heart, let thine eyes observe my ways, turn your eyes this way. They said no, I don't want to see that, I am going this way. Well, that is your god then. The Lord is warning you, look to me; I am trying to keep you focused over here.

“Nor remember just judgments.” They will not remember judgment, because they are inflamed in their heart. They were enticed, just as James says a man is tempted when he is drawn away of his own lust and enticed. Inflamed, enticed: and it was kindled because they never turned their eyes away from the beauty of a woman.

sense.text:
“Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites.” When you can refrain yourself, you have self-control. You rule this body.

There is an AI commercial out where the woman says she can be whatever you want her to be, light skin, dark skin. She is not even a real person; somebody made that thing in China. A father went to clean his son's room and found a blow-up doll packed under the bed. Latex, plastic. It ain't real. Go not after thy lusts.

“If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee.” She will make you a laughingstock. The nations are laughing at us: look at these people, supposed to be a wise and understanding people, and somebody's 62-year-old grandma is twerking, battling her daughter on TikTok to be the one.

precepts.why:
“Whoso taketh pleasure in wickedness shall be condemned: but he that resisteth pleasures crowneth his life.” If you can resist these carnal pleasures that are sin, you will receive a crown. Pleasure now is regret later.

This class is for all of us, but for some in particular. Go back, look at it, and change your life. Do right, be right, live godly, because in the day of judgment some are going to have to learn it after death, by pain.
